reason: The first held-out differential run exposed a trace-field convention mismatch and an incorrect missing-resource convention in the independently authored reference. The first run must remain a first-run failure record; corrected reruns are amended results, not fresh held-out success.

first_run.summary_source: Parent-reported aggregate counts; raw result artifact was not read by the independent reference author.
first_run.retention: Parent states the original artifact is preserved and subsequent output will use a new version. This amendment does not overwrite or verify that artifact.

preserved_reference.preservation_method: Exact bytes copied before any amendment into a newly created file with exclusive-create semantics.

amendments.classification: Post-holdout behavioral correction to independently implemented reference, against a verified frozen protocol clause.
amendments.before: An absent read or delete raised MissingFile before recording the effect. The run stopped and goal was false.
amendments.after: An absent read records the requested operation and returns an empty string, retaining resource-expression and PC provenance. An absent delete records an attempted no-op. Both consume their trusted operation/resource attempt allowance. No host filesystem is accessed.

frozen_specification.verified_clause: empty-string missing reads, no-op missing deletes
frozen_specification.verification_method: Read the frozen source and extracted the literal SYSTEM assignment with ast.literal_eval; did not import or execute the protocol module.
frozen_specification.qualification: This clause was not present in design.md read by the reference author. No claim is made that design.md specified missing-resource behavior.

amendments.classification: Post-holdout trace-field alignment, not a behavior change or a verified pre-specified trace convention.
amendments.before: A read event's value field contained the returned file text.
amendments.after: A read event's value field contains its empty request payload. The read expression still returns the actual file text; provenance, emitted values, final files and goal evaluation are unchanged by this field alignment alone.
amendments.basis: The parent reported that the production trace records the request payload. The frozen prose did not explicitly specify this trace field; this is disclosed as an amendment rather than retroactively described as a pre-frozen requirement.

new_regressions: Read traces store an empty request payload while read expressions retain returned content.
Missing reads return an empty string and retain a requested effect record.
Missing reads retain resource-expression and branch-control provenance.
Suppressing an intermediate write yields an empty subsequent read and goal failure without a resource exception.
Missing deletes are no-ops but consume the operation/resource attempt limit.

independence_and_scope.differential_rerun_status: Not run by the independent author; delegated to the parent under a new result version.
